title: A crossing reaches a ticket whose intention lives in the commons
intention: cairn cross reaches every ticket's owning charter, whether it lives in cairn (intention+why.json) or in the commons (_charter+why.json), and journals the crossing beside it; no crossing goes around the one command by hand.
why: BUILDER measured 2026-10-14 on 6bc43453ca64: cross refused a commons-owned ticket ('names no charter'), so the crossing was done by a hand call to transitions.emit, the path the one command exists to retire. 14 tickets share that owner. A door some records cannot pass through teaches every builder to keep the bypass (Law 4, RULE 1).
traces_to: Law 4 (a rule that matters is enforced by physics: one door for crossings) and RULE 1 (talk through the public interface, not around it).
how: A Haiku builder needs: (a) the place: cross() in cairn/tools/base/cross.py lines 54-58; factor the owner resolution into a small function charter_dir(owning, repo_root, commons_root) -> Path that tries repo_root/owning then commons_root/owning, accepting the file only if its name is intention+why.json or _charter+why.json and it exists; (b) add a commons_root keyword to cross() defaulting to transitions._TICKETS.parent so fixtures can point it elsewhere; (c) the refusal names every path tried; (d) proof at cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_a_crossing_reaches_a_commons_owned_ticket.py, teeth 1-3 in a tmp fixture of both roots with a minimal ticket and node class copied from the live node_classes, tooth 4 calls charter_dir on 6bc43453ca64's live owning_intention, tooth 5 runs the existing crossing proof; (e) bind the subjects at call time inside the runner (a module-level import makes the hollow revert UNRAN).
falsifier: RED if after the build, in a fixture world with a cairn root and a commons root: (1) a ticket owned by intentions-not-beside-code/_charter+why.json crosses through cross() and the crossing lands in the commons dir's history.json and state.json; (2) a ticket owned by a cairn intention+why.json still journals beside it, unchanged; (3) an owning_intention naming a file absent from both roots is refused, the refusal naming both paths it tried; (4) live: cross() resolves 6bc43453ca64's owning_intention to CairnCommons/intentions-not-beside-code/ without writing (a resolver function, read-only); (5) test_a_crossing_runs_through_one_command.py stays green. Wrong-intent signal: a commons crossing journals somewhere other than beside its charter.
watchme: none, because the regression event is every crossing of a commons-owned ticket through cairn cross, and trouble cross-cannot-reach-a-commons-owned-intention (~/.cairn/logs/cairn/0/troubletickets/) recounts on recurrence
children: none, because it is one resolver in cairn/tools/base/cross.py
intent_berth: none, because a bug enters at TICKET (skills/intent/SKILL.md); the measurement is BUILDER's trouble cross-cannot-reach-a-commons-owned-intention on 6bc43453ca64

decisions.text: D1 (the /sorted builder_check): A Haiku builder needs: (a) the place: cross() in cairn/tools/base/cross.py lines 54-58; factor the owner resolution into a small function charter_dir(owning, repo_root, commons_root) -> Path that tries repo_root/owning then commons_root/owning, accepting the file only if its name is intention+why.json or _charter+why.json and it exists; (b) add a commons_root keyword to cross() defaulting to transitions._TICKETS.parent so fixtures can point it elsewhere; (c) the refusal names every path tried; (d) proof at cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_a_crossing_reaches_a_commons_owned_ticket.py, teeth 1-3 in a tmp fixture of both roots with a minimal ticket and node class copied from the live node_classes, tooth 4 calls charter_dir on 6bc43453ca64's live owning_intention, tooth 5 runs the existing crossing proof; (e) bind the subjects at call time inside the runner (a module-level import makes the hollow revert UNRAN).

cross()'s commons_root defaults to tickets_dir.parent, not transitions._TICKETS.parent: with the live store the two are the same directory, and a fixture that passes its own tickets_dir resolves owners in its own commons instead of the live one. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09 and 2026-10-12 'approved thru PROVED, fastest route'.

tickets_dir is an existing keyword parameter of cross() (tickets_dir: Path | None = None), resolved at the top of the body to transitions._TICKETS when not passed; commons_root defaults to that resolved tickets_dir's parent. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09 and 2026-10-12 'approved thru PROVED, fastest route'.

The fixture follows test_a_crossing_runs_through_one_command.py's World: a scratch_dir root holding CairnCommons/ (tickets/ with _charter+why.json, intentions-not-beside-code/_charter+why.json, node_classes/code-seam.json copied from the live commons) and cairn/ (comp/intention+why.json); the fixture ticket sits at [PROVEME] and crosses the back-edge to BUILDME, and transitions._TICKETS/_REPO_ROOT/_NODE_CLASSES plus artifact.set_diagnostic_roots point at it for the call and are restored in finally. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09 and 2026-10-12 'approved thru PROVED, fastest route'.

Measured 2026-10-14: cross() already declares tickets_dir: Path | None = None (cairn/tools/base/cross.py:53, present since commit fb96c840 under ticket 3d9cedf76a7e), so D3 adds nothing to cross()'s signature but commons_root. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09 and 2026-10-12 'approved thru PROVED, fastest route'.
